fields.scope: All work on levels 8 to 10 and all lifting by tower crane TC-2
fields.reason: A load fell during a pick and a worker was hurt. The cause is not known.
fields.conditionsToResume: The cause is found, the rigging is inspected, the safety director and the engineer of record agree in writing, and the owner is told.
fields.distribution: All subcontractors, owner's representative, safety director, project executive
